map.：消防通道占用（3 分）优先于草坪枯黄（2 分），先清占再补绿，权重高项对总评分: : fire exit blockage (3 points) outranks yellowing lawn (2 points), so clear the blockage first and replant after, since higher-weight items affect the total score more.
